clips.title: The story
paras: The Ruins of Aboraz are ancient Gurubashi stone ruins nestled along the southeastern cliffs of Stranglethorn Vale. Once part of the sprawling jungle troll empire, the crumbling terraces now serve as the secluded redoubt for the renegade witch doctor Zanzil the Outcast and his mind-addled thralls.

Perched on the bluffs southeast of the Ruins of Jubuwal and south of the Crystalvein Mine, the weathered masonry of Aboraz has been transformed into an alchemical testing ground. Zanzil the Outcast was banished by the local tribes and the mainlanders alike, retreating here to brew potent mind-altering concoctions and toxic elixirs. Within the stone courtyards, Zanzil exerts total control over an unsettling menagerie of servitors, including shambling undead ghouls, corrupted troll thralls, and even co-opted coastal naga.
